Colombia's birth rate just hit the lowest level ever recorded.

Colombia's national statistics agency DANE says the fertility rate fell to 1.0 child per woman in 2025, the lowest in its series and one of the lowest in the world.

• 2016: 1.7 children per woman. 2025: 1.0
• 441,537 babies born in 2025, 205,984 fewer than in 2016
• Bogotá is at 0.8. Caldas is at 0.7

Replacement level is 2.1.

Source: DANE Estadísticas Vitales
